phase_name: The mutation -- write the five v2 fields on all twelve entries

objectives.description: Write data/migrate12_mutate.py adapted from task 457's phase6_mutate.py
Give the script a hard refusal precondition
Give the script an explicit allow-list of the twelve ids and five mutable keys
Run the script; capture per-entry before/after output into progress file
Immediately re-parse index.json and confirm entry count unchanged against Phase 1 live baseline

refusal_path_exercise.method: Ran migrate12_mutate.py against a scratch copy of index.json (md5 8149f3fc568c199cb814e3d3ccca65d4, identical to the live file at that point) with a deliberately blanked adjudication.tsv row (brics-rs-94-7's proposed_provenance_fidelity column cleared).
refusal_path_exercise.result: Script exited 1, printed 'REFUSING TO RUN -- manual-read precondition not satisfied for all twelve entries: - brics-rs-94-7: missing provenance_fidelity in adjudication.tsv' to stderr, and the scratch copy's md5 was unchanged after the run -- confirming no write occurred on refusal.
refusal_path_exercise.then_confirmed_happy_path: Immediately re-ran the unmodified script against the same scratch copy with the real (unblanked) adjudication.tsv and scope5-12.tsv; it succeeded (exit 0), wrote all twelve entries correctly, and the scratch copy's entry count remained 369 -- confirming the precondition gate is enforced (fails closed) without being decorative (succeeds open when satisfied).

real_mutation.script_run: python3 specs/458_migrate_12_legacy_literature_entries_to_v2_schema/data/migrate12_mutate.py (no override args -- ran against the live ~/Projects/Literature/index.json)

notes: The dry refusal-path exercise and the real mutation both ran cleanly. All twelve entries now carry provenance_fidelity, path, token_count, doc_type; source_format is present only on rutten-2000-universal-coalgebra and rumberg-zanardo-2019-transition-structures (both 'pdf'), matching the ten-EXCLUDE / two-pdf split from Phase 4. Phase 6 performs the independent verification (field-level diff, independent token_count recomputation, FTS gate).
